text: Machine learning is a type of technology that allows computers to learn from data without being programmed for every situation. In supervised learning, a computer is given training data, which includes examples with correct answers. The computer uses this data to build a model. A model is like a set of rules that helps the computer make predictions about new information. For example, a model can predict whether an email is spam or not. After training, we test the model to check its accuracy, which means how often its predictions are correct. The better the training data, the more accurate the predictions will be.
